name: c409_12_gc_refuses_unflushed
covers: GC refuses, unconfirmed commit-key flush: on Tauri a commit's commit-key write reports that it was not flushed to stable storage, and a collection pass of that page refuses to delete anything while the commit key is unconfirmed

pending.reason: The Tauri semantic store reports every durable write flushed: it has no flush fault (the real backend tests drive the flush.fault hook of their own stand-in). The fault, a commit-key write that resolves flushed:false so that the session's idle reason is set, is the Tauri half of 2f-5. The schedule is written against the actor interface; its fault entry is not expressible until then and is not faked.

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u; A: a: open, commit on the Tauri page, with the commit-key write reporting flushed:false (the fault to be added)
labels.GC: begin pass; GC: list keys; GC: read: a: gcPass on the same page: the session's idleReason is set, so the pass ends refused:idle before it reads anything, and deletes nothing
